lines.text: Amos, a sheepherder of Tekoa, saw this vision two years before the earthquake, and the LORD roars from Zion.
The LORD judges Damascus for threshing Gilead with sledges of iron, and the people of Aram will be exiled to Egypt.
The LORD sends fire on Gaza and Tyre for delivering exiles up to Edom, and Tyre also broke a covenant of brotherhood.
The Ammonites ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead to enlarge their territory, so fire will fall on Rabbah and their king will go into exile.
Moab burned the bones of Edom's king to lime, and Judah rejects the Law of the LORD, so fire will consume the citadels of Samaria.
